title: ShopYt
tagline: A website where you can buy and exchange stuff using crypto. Supports OMS strategies as well
description:
This website is a modern, crypto-powered marketplace where people can buy, sell, and exchange goods or services directly using cryptocurrency. When you land on the homepage, you see a clean and minimal design showcasing trending items, featured sellers, and easy-to-browse categories like electronics, fashion, collectibles, digital goods, and services. Users can connect their crypto wallet, such as MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet, with a single click to get started.

For buyers, the process is simple—browse products, pay instantly in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or USDC, and track your order status. Sellers can quickly list their items, set prices in crypto, and receive payments directly to their wallets. The site also features a peer-to-peer exchange section, allowing users to swap items or crypto with one another without relying on a middleman.

All transactions are powered by smart contracts, which provide escrow protection and ensure funds are only released once both parties confirm delivery. This on-chain transparency builds trust, while seller ratings and reviews—stored immutably on the blockchain—add an extra layer of accountability. For community trust and safety, disputes can be resolved through decentralized arbitration.

The platform also supports multiple blockchains and integrates NFTs, enabling users to trade both physical and digital collectibles. To encourage engagement, there’s even a loyalty program that rewards users in crypto tokens. Altogether, it feels like a Web3 blend of eBay, Craigslist, and OpenSea, giving users a seamless and decentralized way to buy, sell, and exchange through crypto.
